name: Shrine of Bás
description: Each shrine dedicated to this god is imbued with elements of death and ice, both inside and out. The exterior has some statues of kemets carrying torches of cold blue flame. An enormous pylon made of tameranium floats above the shrine, emanating intense cold energy that creates the Deep Freeze zone. Many structures on the interior are made of pure ice, such as the altar, chalice, and even statues. Some frozen tombs with the bodies of traitors are displayed there. Typically, the shrine is attended by at least three priests of Bás, alongside some experienced warriors, and undead to secure the place. If invaded, the shrine’s defenders can manipulate the cold and unleash the traitors, reanimated as frosty undead. The Pylon becomes exposed and can be destroyed (100 hit points, AC 15, damage threshold 15) if the central altar is ruined.
